CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL cred_decathlon
WITH 
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_silver
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://decathalonstorageshubham.blob.core.windows.net/silver',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_decathlon
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_gold
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://decathalonstorageshubham.blob.core.windows.net/gold',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_decathlon
)
